profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at McLane Intelligent Solutions
profile.summary:
Accomplished background in web development using a variety of technologies. Experienced in team leadership with creative and motivated individuals dedicated to quickly and successfully completing time sensitive projects.

10 years in the game development industry on titles ranging from mobile to PC working with proprietary engines and Unity.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.insights: Active Server Pages (ASP), Front-End Development and +7 skills

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Develop Web Applications using Asp.net MVC5 with Javascript and Jquery as well as integrations with accounting software.

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description: JOP Studios was created to launch an independently created shoot 'em up game called Star Gods, which released on Itch.io in October and Steam in November.

positions.title: Game Designer
positions.description: Contract work for a 3rd person shooter.

positions.title: Game Designer
positions.description:
in the industry for 6 years
                      TKO Software 2005
                         Lead QA for Leisure Suit Larry: Pocket Party and Codename: Gunforge on Nokia mobile
                         devices
                         3D Level Designer for 3D adventure game titled Ms. Pac-Man Maze Madness 2 (multi-
                         SKU) in Maya 5.0
                         Designed and implemented maps, units, animations and scenarios for Heaven Vs Hell, an
                         unreleased RTS title.
                      Method Solutions 2005-2011
                         Game and Lead Level Designer for all Method Solutions games. In charge of proposals,
                         GDD work and implementation using in-house Fusion editor capable of 2D and 3D.
                         Scripted events in unreleased guitar rhythm-type game including effects and 3D camera
                         work. Also included song implementation and note placement.
                         Scripted enemy behavior in Space Impact: Kappa Base
                         3D track creation in Maya for Car Stars, a 3D mobile racing game
                         Created concept documentation for an unreleased FPS game
                         Experience in Facebook game design
